description: This file defines an interface for a bank account grain in an Orleans-based distributed application, along with related transaction classes for serialization and logging purposes.
external_methods: Task Deposit(uint amount, Guid guid, string desc)
Task<bool> Withdraw(uint amount, Guid guid, string desc)

classes.name: Transaction
classes.description: Abstract base class representing a financial transaction with properties for GUID, description, and issue time.

classes.name: DepositTransaction
classes.description: Derived class representing a deposit transaction with an additional DepositAmount property.

classes.name: WithdrawalTransaction
classes.description: Derived class representing a withdrawal transaction with an additional WithdrawalAmount property.

methods.name: Balance
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves the current account balance.

methods.name: Deposit
methods.description: Asynchronously deposits a specified amount into the account, with an associated GUID and description.

methods.name: Withdraw
methods.description: Asynchronously withdraws a specified amount from the account, with an associated GUID and description.

methods.name: GetTransactionLog
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves the list of transaction records.

calls: Deposit(uint amount, Guid guid, string desc)
Withdraw(uint amount, Guid guid, string desc)
